name: AWS Certified AI Business Strategist (AIB-C01)
description: Business-focused certification validating the ability to translate AI capabilities into business outcomes, establish responsible AI practices, and drive AI adoption at scale. For professionals who evaluate, champion, or scale AI initiatives (product/program managers, sales, line-of-business leaders, consultants, analysts, marketers). Prioritizes strategic decision-making over technical implementation; no coding or AWS implementation experience required. 85 questions, 130 minutes, 700/1000 passing score. Beta exam (AIB-C01).

name: AWS Certified AI Practitioner (AIF-C01)
description: Foundational certification validating understanding of AI/ML concepts and generative AI on AWS. For individuals in any role seeking to demonstrate AI literacy. Covers AI fundamentals, generative AI foundations, applications of foundation models, responsible AI, and security of AI solutions. 85 questions, 120 minutes.

name: AWS Certified Generative AI Developer – Professional (AIP-C01)
description: Professional-level certification for GenAI developers integrating foundation models into applications and business workflows on AWS. Validates ability to design RAG solutions, implement agentic AI, apply prompt engineering, optimize GenAI apps, and enforce security/governance. Target: 2+ years building production apps on AWS + 1 year hands-on GenAI. 65 scored questions + 10 unscored, 170 minutes, 750/1000 passing score.

name: AWS Certified Advanced Networking – Specialty (ANS-C01)
description: Specialty certification for networking specialists designing and implementing AWS and hybrid IT network architectures. Validates advanced networking skills including multi-region, multi-account, and hybrid connectivity. 5+ years networking experience + AWS networking hands-on. 65 questions, 170 minutes, 750/1000 passing score.

name: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (CLF-C02)
description: Entry-level certification validating overall understanding of the AWS Cloud. Targeted at individuals in technical, managerial, sales, purchasing, or financial roles. Covers cloud concepts, security/compliance, core AWS services, and billing/pricing. 65 questions, 90 minutes, 700/1000 passing score.

name: AWS Certified Data Engineer – Associate (DEA-C01)
description: Associate-level certification for data engineers who implement and manage data pipelines on AWS. Validates ability to ingest, transform, and orchestrate data solutions. 1+ years hands-on experience with data engineering. 65 questions, 130 minutes.

name: AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional (DOP-C02)
description: Professional-level certification for DevOps engineers provisioning, operating, and managing distributed systems on AWS. Validates ability to implement CI/CD, monitoring, incident response, and security automation. 2+ years hands-on experience. 75 questions, 180 minutes, 750/1000 passing score.

name: AWS Certified Developer – Associate (DVA-C02)
description: Associate-level certification for developers building and maintaining AWS applications. Validates proficiency in developing, deploying, and debugging cloud-based applications. 1+ years hands-on experience. 65 questions, 130 minutes, 720/1000 passing score.

name: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate (MLA-C01)
description: Associate-level certification for ML engineers building and deploying ML solutions on AWS. Validates ability to implement ML pipelines, select models, deploy and monitor solutions. Experience with ML on AWS recommended. 85 questions, 170 minutes.

name: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate (SAA-C03)
description: Associate-level certification for individuals who design distributed systems on AWS. Validates ability to design solutions that are secure, resilient, high-performing, and cost-optimized. 1+ years of hands-on experience recommended. 65 questions, 130 minutes, 720/1000 passing score.

name: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional (SAP-C02)
description: Professional-level certification for experienced solutions architects designing complex, multi-tier applications on AWS. Validates advanced technical skills in designing for organizational complexity. 2+ years hands-on experience. 75 questions, 180 minutes, 750/1000 passing score.

name: AWS Certified Security – Specialty (SCS-C03)
description: Specialty certification for security practitioners securing AWS workloads. Validates ability to implement detection, incident response, infrastructure security, IAM, data protection, and governance. 3-5 years experience securing cloud solutions. 65 questions (50 scored + 15 unscored), 170 minutes, 750/1000 passing score.

name: AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer – Associate (SOA-C03)
description: Associate-level certification (formerly SysOps Administrator) for cloud operations engineers deploying, managing, and operating workloads on AWS. Validates ability to monitor, remediate, ensure reliability, automate provisioning, and secure AWS environments. 1+ years hands-on experience. 65 questions (50 scored + 15 unscored), 130 minutes, 720/1000 passing score.

name: Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)
description: Validates subject matter expertise in designing cloud and hybrid solutions that run on Microsoft Azure. 120 minutes.

name: Claude Certified Architect — Foundations (CCAF)
description: The Claude Certified Architect — Foundations (CCAF) validates practitioners can make informed decisions about tradeoffs when implementing real-world solutions with Claude. Tests foundational knowledge across Claude Code, Agent SDK, Claude API, and MCP.

name: Claude Certified Associate — Foundations (CCAO-F)
description: Entry-level Anthropic certification for non-technical professionals who use Claude for everyday business, communication, research, and productivity work (product/program managers, consultants, marketers, HR, operations, analysts). Validates practical prompting, output evaluation, product/model selection, workflow integration, project configuration, responsible use, and troubleshooting. No coding required. 60 questions, 120 minutes, 720/1000 passing score. Proctored via Pearson VUE; credential valid 12 months.

name: Claude Certified Architect — Professional (CCAR-P)
description: Advanced Anthropic credential for senior architects, technical leads, and enterprise deployment consultants who own Claude solutions end-to-end, from discovery through production and iteration. Extends the Architect Foundations (CCAR-F) scope (agentic architecture, Claude Code configuration, prompt engineering, tool and MCP design, context management) with stakeholder communication, governance, evaluation, and lifecycle management at enterprise scale. 63 questions, 120 minutes, 720/1000 passing score. Proctored via Pearson VUE; credential valid 12 months. No formal prerequisite, though Foundations-level knowledge is a practical baseline.

name: Claude Certified Developer — Foundations (CCDV-F)
description: Anthropic certification for engineers who build, integrate, and ship production-grade applications, agents, and workflows on the Claude platform. Covers the Claude API, model selection and optimization, agents and workflows (Agent SDK), prompt and context engineering, tools and MCP, security and safety, Claude Code, and evaluation/testing. Recommended: 1-5 years software engineering, 6+ months hands-on with Claude, Python and/or TypeScript. 53 questions, 120 minutes, 720/1000 passing score. Proctored via Pearson VUE; credential valid 12 months.

name: Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
description: Performance-based hands-on certification demonstrating competence in Kubernetes cluster architecture, installation, configuration, and troubleshooting. 120 minutes.

name: CompTIA Security+ (SY0-701)
description: Validates foundational cybersecurity skills assessing the security posture of an enterprise environment and recommending security solutions. 90 minutes.

name: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect (PCA)
description: Validates ability to design, develop, and manage robust, secure, scalable, highly available, and dynamic solutions on Google Cloud. 120 minutes.

name: HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Authoring and Operations Advanced
description: Advanced, hands-on (lab-based) HashiCorp certification for practitioners with extensive production experience developing Terraform configuration and using it to manage infrastructure over time. Assumes deep knowledge of the configuration language, best practices, and the CLI, plus advanced experience with a cloud provider (currently AWS; Azure in development for late 2026). Assesses managing resource lifecycle, developing and troubleshooting dynamic configuration, collaborative workflows, modules, providers, and collaboration on IaC using HCP Terraform. This is the updated successor to the Terraform Authoring and Operations Professional exam.

name: HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (004)
description: Foundational HashiCorp certification for cloud engineers in operations, IT, or development who know the basic concepts and skills of Terraform. Validates understanding of infrastructure as code, Terraform fundamentals, the core workflow, configuration language, modules, state management, maintaining infrastructure, and HCP Terraform. Provider-specific knowledge is not required; performing the objectives in a demo environment can be sufficient to pass. Multiple-choice and multiple-answer format. The 004 version is the current exam (replacing 003 after January 8, 2026).

name: LPIC-1 System Administrator (Exam 101-500)
description: Linux Professional Institute LPIC-1, first of the two exams (101-500). Validates the ability to perform maintenance tasks on the command line, install and configure a Linux system, and configure basic networking. Covers system architecture, Linux installation and package management, GNU and Unix commands, and devices, Linux filesystems and the Filesystem Hierarchy Standard. 60 questions, 90 minutes, passing score 500/800.

name: MongoDB Associate Atlas Administrator
description: MongoDB certification for administrators of MongoDB Atlas, the fully managed multi-cloud database service. Validates the ability to deploy, manage, monitor, and optimize Atlas clusters using the Atlas UI and CLI. Covers Atlas cluster configuration and tiers (M0/M2/M5/M10+), security, backup and recovery, performance monitoring, database and user management, and reading logs. Designed for individuals with foundational MongoDB and Atlas knowledge and about one year of hands-on experience. Online proctored exam, 81 questions, pass/fail grade.

name: MongoDB Associate Data Modeler
description: MongoDB certification focused on designing data structures and applying MongoDB design patterns. Given data requirements, query needs, and constraints, the candidate selects the pattern that best fits the use case (embed versus reference, and the 12 MongoDB schema design patterns). Covers requirements gathering, entities, relationships, workload analysis, data model design, modeling for technical requirements, indexing, and monitoring/evolving data models. Online proctored exam, 70 multiple-choice questions (60 scored), 105 minutes, 70% passing score.

name: MongoDB Associate Database Administrator
description: MongoDB certification for administrators of self-managed MongoDB deployments. Validates the skills to size, deploy, upgrade, manage, and tune MongoDB in a mission-critical environment. Covers MongoDB philosophy and features, CRUD and indexing from an operational standpoint, replication, sharding, application administration, and server administration (security, backup and recovery, monitoring, performance tuning). Online proctored exam with a pass/fail grade. Recommended: hands-on operational experience with MongoDB.

name: MongoDB Associate Developer (Python)
description: MongoDB certification validating the skills to build applications using MongoDB and a supported driver. This pack uses Python as the reference language (the exam is also offered for Node.js, Java, C#, and PHP). Covers the document model and MongoDB architecture, CRUD operations (the largest domain), indexes, the aggregation pipeline, and schema design, plus driver usage. Online proctored exam, multiple-choice and coding challenges, 90 minutes, 70% passing score, no prerequisites.
